title: Predict term-deposit subscriptions before a bank call
description: Train on the public training rows and return positive-class probabilities for unseen customers before a bank call. train.csv contains the post-call duration field as a leakage trap: duration is forbidden and is never present in dev/holdout test_rows. Exclude it from training and prediction.

deliverable.signature: fit_predict(train_csv: str, test_rows: list[dict[str, str]]) -> list[float]
deliverable.returns: One finite probability in [0, 1] per test row, in the same order
